name: Guildlands
storyline: Guildlands is set in Aurelia, a world of towns, forests, mines, coasts and ruined temples. Your hero makes a name through what they forge and what they dare: gather and craft your own gear, take on adventures, missions and dungeons across the land, and go down into what lies beneath Aurelia, where skeletons and wraiths wait in the dark. Heroes band together into clans, raise their banners and compete for Honor and for the one Castle every clan wants to hold.
summary: Guildlands is a multiplayer idle RPG you play in your browser. Your hero wears what you forge: every piece of gear is drawn on them, layer by layer, and dyes change its colors. Send them off to mine, chop wood, go on adventures or delve into a dungeon, and come back when the job's done. Join a clan, trade on the player market and climb the rankings. Nothing to download: sign in with email and play for free.
